svg.title: 29. Single knee to chest — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Lie on your back with both knees bent. Hold behind one thigh and bring that knee towards your chest. Keep your head relaxed and the other foot on the mat.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/One_Knee_To_Chest.json
